lines.en: label mikupool55:
scene mikupoolscene1
: Hey, Miku. Are you okay? Are you feeling sick or something?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。你还好吗？是不是哪里不舒服？

lines.en: : Is she even awake?
lines.zh: : 她到底是醒着吗？

lines.en: : She is. Her eyes are open. Just barely, though.
lines.zh: : 醒着。她眼睛是睁开的。虽然只是勉强睁开。

lines.en: : Do you guys know if she’s been sleeping well lately? Or anything that might be fatiguing her?
lines.zh: : 你们知不知道她最近睡得好不好？或者有什么会让她这么疲惫的事？

lines.en: : If this was anyone else, I’d say she just needs a day to recharge or something. But Miku’s a different story and I feel like she recharges {i}by{/i} being active.
lines.zh: : 换作别人，我会说她只是需要一天时间充充电什么的。但 Miku 不一样，我觉得她是{i}靠{/i}动起来才能充电的。

lines.en: : You mean like a car battery?
lines.zh: : 你是说像汽车电瓶那样？

lines.en: : Sure, if the car battery is a prodigious athlete. Miku, hey. Focus.
lines.zh: : 行吧，如果那个汽车电瓶是个天赋异禀的运动员的话。Miku，嘿。集中注意力。

lines.en: Karin begins to snap her fingers, trying to drag Miku back to reality, but whatever is happening to her right now puts up too strong of a forcefield to let something like a mere {i}sound{/i} drag her out of it.
lines.zh: Karin 开始打响指，想把 Miku 拉回现实，可她身上正在发生的状况竖起了一道太强的力场，光凭一点{i}声音{/i}根本没法把她从里面拽出来。

lines.en: It’s a little ironic when you think about it.
lines.zh: 仔细想想，这还挺讽刺的。

lines.en: Well, maybe not {i}ironic{/i} as tying any sort of expectation to any sort of mental illness is just asking to be proven wrong in one way or another.
lines.zh: 嗯，也许算不上{i}讽刺{/i}吧，毕竟对任何精神疾病抱有任何预期，都只是在自找打脸。

lines.en: But the only reason she got into this mess in the first place was to {i}prevent{/i} sound from reaching her.
lines.zh: 可她当初会落到这步田地，唯一的原因就是想{i}不让{/i}声音传到她那儿。

lines.en: And now that it can’t, look at what we’re left with.
lines.zh: 而现在声音真的传不进去了，看看我们剩下的是什么。

lines.en: Maybe there’s more to it than that. In fact, there {i}has{/i} to be more to it than that.
lines.zh: 也许事情不止于此。事实上，事情{i}一定{/i}不止于此。

lines.en: The voice of vibration and its incessant mockery of this poor girl is just what {i}we{/i} can bear witness to.
lines.zh: 那振动之声，以及它对这可怜女孩无休止的嘲弄，不过是{i}我们{/i}所能目睹的那一部分。

lines.en: Who knows what must lurk inside of her? Who knows what it is that {i}we{/i} can’t see?
lines.zh: 谁知道她心里潜伏着什么？谁知道{i}我们{/i}看不见的那部分是什么？

lines.en: And who knows how close I may have come to grazing it with the tips of my fingers during my new and exciting venture into her most private depths.
lines.zh: 又有谁知道，在我那场新鲜又刺激、探入她最私密深处的冒险中，我的指尖离擦碰到它有多近。

lines.en: If I could pull it out, I would.
lines.zh: 如果我能把它拉出来，我会的。

lines.en: If I could reach all the way to her heart and swipe away the fog with a quick flick of the wrist, she wouldn’t need to rely on someone else who’s broken to try and fix her.
lines.zh: 如果我能一路伸到她的心脏，手腕一抖就把那层雾抹掉，她就不需要依赖另一个同样破碎的人来试图修好她了。

lines.en: That sort of thing will never work.
lines.zh: 那种事永远都不会奏效。

lines.en: Ah.
lines.zh: 啊。

lines.en: {i}There’s{/i} the irony.
lines.zh: {i}讽刺就在这儿。{/i}

lines.en: : Do you need to go to the nurse’s office? Do you want us to call Maki?
lines.zh: : 你需要去医务室吗？要不要我们叫 Maki 来？

lines.en: : Do you need {i}anything?{/i} Can you even hear me right now?
lines.zh: : 你需要{i}什么{/i}吗？你现在还听得见我说话吗？

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene2
: What the heck? Where did this even come from? She was fine earlier.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？这是从哪儿冒出来的？她刚才还好好的。

lines.en: : Should I go get Makoto? She should still be in the class or Sensei’s office or something. Maybe she’ll know what to do?
lines.zh: : 要不要我去叫 Makoto？她应该还在教室或者 Sensei 的办公室什么的。也许她知道该怎么办？

lines.en: : You can try. But if it really is fatigue, I don’t think there’s anything we {i}can{/i} do but let her rest. And the pool isn’t exactly the best place for that.
lines.zh: : 你{i}可以{/i}试试。不过如果真的只是疲劳，我想除了让她休息也没别的办法。而泳池实在不是休息的最佳场所。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene3
: Sensei, I’m sorry to ask such a big favor of you- but would you mind bringing Miku to the nurse’s office? I’d do it myself, but I promised Miss Imai I’d take care of everything here in her absence.
lines.zh: : Sensei，很抱歉要拜托你这么大的忙——你能不能把 Miku 送到医务室去？我本来想自己去的，可我答应过 Imai 老师，她不在的时候这里的一切都由我照看。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: That’s the wrong idea.
lines.zh: 这主意不行。

lines.en: As the one person here who knows this isn’t just “fatigue,” taking Miku to the nurse’s office won’t do anything but make what’s likely wrong with her even more apparent.
lines.zh: 作为这里唯一一个知道这不只是“疲劳”的人，把 Miku 送到医务室只会让她身上可能出的问题变得更明显。

lines.en: And that will incriminate me. Or {i}could{/i} incriminate me if either Miku or Io accidentally mention to someone that this is something I’ve known about.
lines.zh: 而那会让我获罪。或者说，如果 Miku 或 Io 不小心跟别人提起这件事我早就知道，就{i}足以{/i}让我获罪。

lines.en: But they wouldn’t do that, right? Even if they talk too much, they wouldn’t do that. They like me. And nobody else-
lines.zh: 可她们不会那么做的，对吧？就算她们话多，也不会那么做。她们喜欢我。而其他人——

lines.en: Makoto. Makoto would figure it out. She’d figure out that this is something I’ve been aware of. I’ve given her so many hints.
lines.zh: Makoto。Makoto 会想明白的。她会想明白这件事我一直都知道。我给过她那么多暗示了。

lines.en: And it would not only ruin my relationship with her if this is serious, but open me up to further consequences as well if she made my involvement publicly known. Which she {i}might.{/i}
lines.zh: 而如果这事很严重，那不仅会毁掉我和她的关系，要是她把我的参与公开出去，我还会面临更多后果。而她{i}很可能{/i}会这么做。

lines.en: Because even if {i}she{/i} likes me, this is an area she won’t budge on. Even if {i}she{/i} likes me, she likes {i}Miku{/i} more. And she’ll know that I’ve been letting this happen.
lines.zh: 因为就算{i}她{/i}喜欢我，这件事上她也不会让步。就算{i}她{/i}喜欢我，她更喜欢 {i}Miku{/i}。而她会知道，我是眼睁睁看着这一切发生的。

lines.en: Taking Miku to the nurse will ignite a spark that could burn down my entire life. I can’t have that. I can’t risk losing anything over taking her to the wrong place.
lines.zh: 把 Miku 送去医务室，就是点燃一簇足以烧掉我整个人生的火星。我不能让这事发生。我不能因为把她送错地方，就冒险失去一切。

lines.en: I should take her somewhere quieter. Safer. But not so quiet and safe that no one would ever find her. Besides, she’ll be okay. Right? She probably just took too much of something and needs to come down.
lines.zh: 我应该带她去更安静、更安全的地方。但也不能安静安全到永远没人找得到她。再说，她会没事的。对吧？她大概只是吃了太多某种东西，需要缓一缓。

lines.en: Everything will be fine. I should hide this. If I hide it, I can talk to her when she’s more conscious and make her stop.
lines.zh: 一切都会好起来的。我应该把这事瞒下来。只要瞒下来，等她清醒些我再跟她谈，让她别再吃了。

lines.en: There’s no need to risk destroying anything over this. I can just take her somewhere else. It’s that easy. I’m such a genius.
lines.zh: 没必要为了这个冒险毁掉什么。我把她带到别处去就行。就这么简单。我真是天才。

lines.en: : What if I just took her back to the dorm?
lines.zh: : 那我把她送回宿舍怎么样？

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene4
: The dorm? But that’s like a mile away. And I highly doubt Miku will be able to walk in this condition if she’s not even waking up for me.
lines.zh: : 宿舍？可那得有一英里远吧。而且她连我叫都不醒，我很怀疑她这状态还能走路。

lines.en: : Then I’ll carry her. It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 那我就背着她。没关系。

lines.en: : You’re going to...carry her all the way back there?
lines.zh: : 你要……一路把她背回去？

lines.en: : It’s fine. Look at her. She can’t weigh any more than like 80lbs max.
lines.zh: : 没关系。你看她那样子，撑死了也就八十磅。

lines.en: : I mean...you’re the teacher. And I know better than to talk back if you think you know what’s best. So if that’s your decision, okay. But I’d appreciate if you’d text me when you get to her room.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你是老师。而且你要是觉得你最清楚该怎么做，我也知道不该顶嘴。所以如果你这么决定了，那就行。不过你到了她房间，麻烦给我发个短信。

lines.en: : Just let me take her back to the locker room and change her clothes before-
lines.zh: : 至少让我带她回更衣室换身衣服再——

lines.en: : I’ll just carry her like that. Stripping a girl while she’s unconscious isn’t really a thing we’re supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 我就这么背着她走。在女生昏迷的时候把她的衣服脱掉，这可不是我们该干的事。

lines.en: : Besides, putting her normal clothes back on might overheat her. She needs to get some rest as soon as possible. She can get dressed when she wakes back up.
lines.zh: : 再说，给她换回平常的衣服可能会让她过热。她需要尽快休息。等她醒了再穿也行。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene5
: A...Again...if that’s what you think is best...
lines.zh: : 那……再说一次……如果你觉得这样最好……

lines.en: : It is. I’ve thought a lot about this.
lines.zh: : 是的。我想了很久。

lines.en: : Come on, Miku. We’re going now.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Miku。我们现在出发。

lines.en: scene black
I make my way over to Miku and lift her off of the bench.
lines.zh: 我走到 Miku 身边，把她从长椅上抱起来。

lines.en: It’s clear that Karin is worried about what’s going on here and what I’ve decided to do, but that worry will only be temporary.
lines.zh: 看得出来，Karin 很担心眼前的情况、也很担心我的决定，不过这份担心只是暂时的。

lines.en: Once Miku goes back to normal and regains control of her limbs, this will all fade and there will never be anything to worry about again.
lines.zh: 等 Miku 恢复正常、重新掌控自己的四肢，这一切都会烟消云散，就再也不用担心什么了。

lines.en: She’ll be good as new in no time at all. And it’ll all be because of me and how I avoided revealing to everyone that she’s casually overdosing on medication that wasn’t prescribed to her.
lines.zh: 她很快就会完好如初。而这一切都要归功于我，归功于我没有让大家知道她在随便过量服用那些并不是开给她的药。

lines.en: You’re welcome, Miku. And Io. And everyone else that I am saving and/or protecting by deciding to do this.
lines.zh: 不用谢，Miku。还有 Io。以及所有因为我这个决定而被我拯救、或者被我保护的人。

lines.en: This is the right choice. I am making the right choice.
lines.zh: 这是正确的选择。我正在做正确的选择。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene6
I am making the right choice.
lines.zh: 我正在做正确的选择。

lines.en: And if anything happens to her, it won’t be my fault.
lines.zh: 而且就算她出了什么事，那也不是我的错。

lines.en: Except it will.
lines.zh: 除了它就是。

lines.en: But it won’t.
lines.zh: 但它不是。

lines.en: It will be Io’s fault.
lines.zh: 那是 Io 的错。

lines.en: I told her to stop this.
lines.zh: 我叫她别再这么干了。

lines.en: I did my part.
lines.zh: 我做了我该做的。

lines.en: And there’s nothing I could have done to avoid this.
lines.zh: 而我根本没办法避免这件事。

lines.en: Which is why I will fix it now.
lines.zh: 所以我现在要把它修好。

lines.en: Which is why I will take her home.
lines.zh: 所以我要带她回家。

lines.en: And it is there she will recover and we’ll laugh all about this the next time we talk.
lines.zh: 她会在那儿好起来，下次我们聊天的时候，会把这事当成笑话讲。

lines.en: I am making the right choice.
lines.zh: 我正在做正确的选择。

lines.en: : Sensei?...Is she a little heavy after all? If you really need help, I can-
lines.zh: : Sensei？……她是不是其实有点重？要是你真的需要帮忙，我可以——

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene7
: No. I’m fine. I’m making the right choice.
lines.zh: : 不用。我没事。我正在做正确的选择。

lines.en: : I...I trust your judgement. But again, please let me know as soon as-
lines.zh: : 我……我相信你的判断。不过还是那句话，请你一——

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, Miku. It’s time to go home.
lines.zh: : 走吧，Miku。该回家了。

lines.en: : As soon as...
: ...you get to her room.
lines.zh: : ……到她房间就告诉我。

lines.en: scene noonsky
This isn’t so bad.
lines.zh: 这还不算太糟。

lines.en: She really {i}is{/i} light.
lines.zh: 她真的{i}很轻{/i}。

lines.en: And she doesn’t even smell like chlorine since she never made it into the pool today.
lines.zh: 而且她身上连氯气的味道都没有，因为她今天压根没下泳池。

lines.en: All things considered, this could have gone a lot worse.
lines.zh: 总的来说，情况本来可能会糟得多。

lines.en: People could be looking at me.
lines.zh: 本来可能会有人在看我。

lines.en: But no one seems to care that I’m carrying a partially conscious teenage girl wearing nothing but skintight latex to {b}GOD{/b} knows where in broad daylight.
lines.zh: 可似乎没人在意我光天化日之下抱着一个半清醒、只穿着紧身乳胶衣的少女，走向{b}天知道{/b}什么地方。

lines.en: This is a totally normal thing and I’m totally normal for doing it and Miku is going to be totally fine and it’ll be totally awesome.
lines.zh: 这完全是件正常的事，我做这件事也完全正常，Miku 会完全没事的，一切都会棒极了。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene8
Oh, okay. I guess we’re here now. That’s good. I saved the day.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧。看来我们到了。很好。我拯救了这一天。

lines.en: I wonder when her eyes closed.
lines.zh: 我在想她的眼睛是什么时候闭上的。

lines.en: She’s still breathing. I can see the air exiting and entering her body. Just not the literal air. What I mean is that her body is moving. But only the part that air goes into. Which I guess also isn’t accurate but-
lines.zh: 她还在呼吸。我能看见空气进出她的身体。当然不是字面意义上的“看见空气”。我的意思是，她的身体在动。但只有空气进去的那一处在动。这么说大概也不太准确，不过——

lines.en: Anyway, we’re here. I did my job. Time to put Miku into her bed and then leave because what she needs is rest and not medical attention. You know what they say about time being the best medicine and all.
lines.zh: 总之，我们到了。我干完活了。该把 Miku 放上床，然后走人了，因为她需要的是休息，而不是医疗照护。毕竟人家都说时间是最好的药什么的。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene9
Okay. She’s in bed now. Job done.
lines.zh: 好。她上床了。活干完了。

lines.en: But is it okay if she stays like this? Should I take her clothes off? Is she too hot? Is she too cold? Does she need another blanket or no blanket at all?
lines.zh: 可她就这么待着行吗？我要不要帮她把衣服脱了？她会不会太热？会不会太冷？她需要再加一条毯子，还是一条都不要？

lines.en: Wait. There was something else I was supposed to do, wasn’t there?
lines.zh: 等等。我还有别的事要做，对吧？

lines.en: I have to call someone.
lines.zh: 我得给谁打个电话。

lines.en: But who-
lines.zh: 可是给谁——

lines.en: Nevermind. I remember.
lines.zh: 算了。我想起来了。

lines.en: They answer.
lines.zh: 对方接了。

lines.en: : Hello?
Fuck. No. Not her. Someone else.
lines.zh: 操。不。不该是她。换个人。

lines.en: Uhh...
Screw it. They’ll contact me if it’s really that important and I can just say I don’t remember anything.
lines.zh: 管他呢。要是真有那么重要，他们会再联系我的，我就说我什么都不记得了。

lines.en: A sound slithers through the slight gap in Miku’s lips then grows legs, sprints across the mattress, and throws a grappling hook over my shoulder before climbing up and entering me through my left nostril.
lines.zh: 一个声音从 Miku 微张的唇缝里溜了出来，然后长出腿，飞奔过床垫，把抓钩甩上我的肩膀，再顺着爬上去，从我左边的鼻孔钻了进来。

lines.en: A small man that was living inside of Miku spends the rest of his life building a home inside of my cranium and we all live happily ever after. Isn’t symbolism just the coolest?
lines.zh: 一个一直住在 Miku 体内的小个子男人，用余生在我的颅骨里建了个家，然后我们所有人都幸福地生活在一起。象征手法是不是超酷的？

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene10
Just like I said — I did my job and now everything is good.
lines.zh: 就像我说的——我干完活了，现在一切都好。

lines.en: I have saved Miku’s life and prevented all of us from suffering or losing a valuable member of the class in one fell swoop.
lines.zh: 我救了 Miku 的命，一举避免了我们所有人受苦、也避免了班里失去一位宝贵的成员。

lines.en: Ami would be so proud of me if she could see me right now.
lines.zh: 要是 Ami 现在能看到我，她一定会为我骄傲的。

lines.en: But I’ll call her again just to make sure.
lines.zh: 不过我还是再打一次给她，好确认一下。

lines.en: Here she is.
lines.zh: 她来了。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene11
: Hey! What’s going on? I kinda figured the first call was just an accident since you hung up right away. Do you actually need something?
lines.zh: : 嘿！怎么了？我看你第一个电话马上就挂了，还以为只是误拨呢。你真的有事吗？

lines.en: : No. I just wanted to tell you I did a good job today.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是想告诉你，我今天干得不错。

lines.en: : You...do a good job every day, Sensei. Did something happen, though?
lines.zh: : 你……每天都干得不错啊，Sensei。不过，是出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : No. Nothing happened except for the good deed I did.
lines.zh: : 没有。除了我做的好事之外，什么都没发生。

lines.en: : Where are you?
lines.zh: : 你在哪儿？

lines.en: : Everywhere and nowhere, all at once.
lines.zh: : 无处不在，又哪儿都不在，同时如此。

lines.en: : Do you need me to come get you?
lines.zh: : 需要我来接你吗？

lines.en: I hang up the phone because Ami doesn’t understand and redirect my attention to Miku, whose eyes are now open because I did a thing.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，因为 Ami 不懂，然后把注意力转回 Miku 身上——她的眼睛现在睁开了，因为我做了一件事。

lines.en: : Sensei?...
lines.zh: : Sensei？……

lines.en: : That’s my name. Just it isn’t. My real name is Akira. Hello.
lines.zh: : 那是我的称呼。只不过它不是。我真名叫 Akira。你好。

lines.en: : Wass...goin’ on?...
: Feel like I was just at school a minute ago...How’d I get here?...
lines.zh: : 感觉我一分钟前还在学校……我怎么到这儿来的？……

lines.en: : I carried you here because I’m awesome and responsible and was protecting you from the nurse so we can keep spending time together in the future and I don’t have to leave.
lines.zh: : 我把你背回来的，因为我既厉害又负责，还保护你没被送到护士那儿，这样我们以后还能继续待在一起，我也不必离开。

lines.en: : You carried me here...all the way from school?...Why?...
lines.zh: : 你把我背回来的……一路从学校背过来？……为什么？……

lines.en: : Because you’re a fucking idiot and have been taking random pills that Io gives you for an indeterminate amount of time now.
lines.zh: : 因为你是个该死的白痴，而且这段时间一直都在乱吃 Io 给你的药，吃了多久都不知道。

lines.en: : But I didn’t even take any of those today...
lines.zh: : 可我今天根本没吃那些啊……

lines.en: : What?...
scene mikupoolscene12
: Or maybe I did...I don’t remember...
lines.zh: : 或者我吃了吧……我不记得了……

lines.en: : Well, you’re not anymore. You’re done. No more medication without seeing a doctor first.
lines.zh: : 总之你以后不许再吃了。到此为止。没有医生开的药，一粒都不许吃。

lines.en: : Io says doctors are the worst...
lines.zh: : Io 说医生最讨厌了……

lines.en: : Io says everyone is the worst.
lines.zh: : Io 说所有人都最讨厌。

lines.en: : Not me...Io likes me...
lines.zh: : 我除外……Io 喜欢我……

lines.en: : No, Io likes playing pharmacist — which you go along with because you have the IQ of a rhinoceros beetle and don’t understand the potential consequences of your actions.
lines.zh: : 不，Io 喜欢的是当药剂师——而你就配合她，因为你的智商跟独角仙差不多，根本不懂自己的行为可能带来什么后果。

lines.en: : Maybe...{i}you’re{/i} the one who doesn’t understand?...
lines.zh: : 也许……不懂的人{i}是你{/i}呢？……

lines.en: : That’s exactly what she told me. But you’re both wrong. How much did you take today?
lines.zh: : 她跟我说的一模一样。不过你们两个都错了。你今天吃了多少？

lines.en: : I already told you, I don’t remember. But I won’t take that much again. Promise.
lines.zh: : 我都说了，我不记得了。不过我不会再吃那么多了。我保证。

lines.en: : You can’t keep that promise if you don’t even know how much it was, Miku.
lines.zh: : 你连那是多少都不知道，这个保证你就做不到，Miku。

lines.en: : Heheh...you got me...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……被你抓到了……

lines.en: : Thanks for carryin’ me, though...That was real nice of ya...
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你背我……你真是太好了……

lines.en: : The alternative was taking you to someone who would have understood what was happening and it would have spiraled into something horrible.
lines.zh: : 另一个选择是把你送到一个能看懂发生了什么的人那儿，而那会让事情演变成一场灾难。

lines.en: : How come understanding what’s happening has to be bad?...
lines.zh: : 为什么看懂发生了什么就一定是坏事呢？……

lines.en: : That part isn’t bad. The bad part is how I wouldn’t have been able to keep my mouth shut and how Io could get in trouble for it and how Makoto would stop having sex with me.
lines.zh: : 那部分不坏。坏的是那样一来我就瞒不住了，Io 会因此惹上麻烦，Makoto 也会不跟我上床了。

lines.en: : That’s fine...You can just have sex with me instead...
lines.zh: : 那没关系啊……你跟我上床不就行了……

lines.en: : I probably don’t know the same sex moves as her, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我大概不会她那些床上功夫……

lines.en: : Come on...
lines.zh: : 来嘛……

lines.en: : What’re ya waitin’ for?...
lines.zh: : 你还等什么？……

lines.en: : Do it already...
lines.zh: : 快上啊……

lines.en: : That was your invitation, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 这就是你的邀请了，Sensei……

lines.en: : Ya gonna make me spell it out?...
lines.zh: : 你非要我说得那么明白吗？……

lines.en: : Miku...are you out of your mind?
lines.zh: : Miku……你疯了吗？

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene13
: Yeah.
: I kinda am.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : That’s kinda why I started seein’ Dr. Io in the first place. And it’s been workin’ out real well.
lines.zh: : 这也是我一开始去找 Io 医生的原因。而且效果一直很好。

lines.en: : Just look how long my hair’s gettin’. I ain’t pulled any out in months. And I ain’t scared of anything anymore.
lines.zh: : 你看我头发长多长了。我好几个月没拔过一根了。而且我现在什么都不怕了。

lines.en: : Worst thing that’s happened is you havin’ to carry me home. But even that ain’t bad since ya get to stick it in me now.
lines.zh: : 最糟的事也就是你得背我回家。不过连那也不算糟，因为你现在可以插进我里面了。

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : Really? Is that thing about boys wantin’ sex all the time just a rumor after all? I fall for those pretty easily, so it wouldn’t be weird if I was wrong.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？“男生随时随地都想要”难道只是传闻？我很容易上当的，所以就算我搞错了也不奇怪。

lines.en: : I’m not going to have sex with someone coming down from a minor overdose.
lines.zh: : 我不会跟一个刚从轻微过量中缓过来的人上床。

lines.en: : How long do we gotta wait? Cause I can’t really feel anythin’ right now and figured this would be a good chance to give you my v-card without gettin’ hurt.
lines.zh: : 那我们要等多久？因为我现在什么都感觉不到，想着这倒是个好机会，可以把我的初夜交给你又不会疼。

lines.en: : If you’re okay, I’m going to leave now.
lines.zh: : 如果你没事，我就先走了。

lines.en: : Without even fingering me? But we’re all alone. Ya gotta give me somethin’ here.
lines.zh: : 连手指都不给我一下？可我们就两个人啊。你总得给我点什么吧。

lines.en: : I don’t have to give you anything. And, to be honest, I kind of don’t even want to look at you right now.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不必给你。而且说实话，我现在连看都不太想看你。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene14
: You...bein’ serious?...
lines.zh: : 你……是认真的吗？……

lines.en: : I can’t really tell...
lines.zh: : 我分不太清……

lines.en: : I am. This isn’t like you, Miku. You’re not the type of person to do things like this.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的。这不像你，Miku。你不是会做这种事的人。

lines.en: : S’cuse me for puttin’ it bluntly, but...the heck do you know about who I {i}really{/i} am?
lines.zh: : 恕我直言……你到底了解{i}真正的{/i}我什么啊？

lines.en: : You ain’t got the first idea of what I’m dealin’ with. You don’t get it at all, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我在应付什么，你一点头绪都没有。你根本不懂，Sensei。

lines.en: : It’s hard to get something when you’d rather knock yourself out than open up to me.
lines.zh: : 你要是宁愿把自己搞晕也不肯对我敞开心扉，那我确实很难懂。

lines.en: : You’re the same friggin’ way.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的还不是一样。

lines.en: : I don’t know anythin’ about {i}you{/i} and I still squeeze the cum outta ya because I’m a good friend and we don’t {i}need{/i} to know that kinda stuff about each other.
lines.zh: : 我对{i}你{/i}一无所知，可我还是帮你把精液挤出来，因为我是个好朋友，而我们之间不{i}需要{/i}知道那些东西。

lines.en: : And that’s fair. But your way of avoiding difficult confrontation is slowly killing you.
lines.zh: : 这倒是公平。可你这种逃避正面冲突的方式，正在一点一点地杀死你。

lines.en: scene mikupoolscene15
: So is yours...only difference is that ain’t nobody strong enough to carry you home...
lines.zh: : 你的方式也是……唯一的区别是，没人强壮到能把你背回家……

lines.en: : That’s not the same thing, Miku. This is-
lines.zh: : 那不是一回事，Miku。这是——

lines.en: : Listen, Sensei — my head is kinda poundin’ and my throat is really dry, so if you’re not gonna stick your wiener in me, could ya maybe let me take a nap or somethin’? Thanks.
lines.zh: : 听着，Sensei——我头有点一跳一跳地疼，嗓子也干得要命，所以如果你不打算把你的小兄弟插进来，能不能让我睡个觉什么的？谢啦。

lines.en: : I don’t like this side of you, Miku. This isn’t the person I know.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你这副样子，Miku。这不是我认识的那个人。

lines.en: : Cry me a friggin’ river. Night, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那你慢慢哭去吧。晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
There will be no river, nor tears at all-
lines.zh: 不会有河，也不会有眼泪——

lines.en: For it hurts the most {i}before{/i} the fall.
lines.zh: 因为最痛的，是坠落{i}之前{/i}。

lines.en: Then afterwards, with broken bones-
lines.zh: 而在那之后，骨头断裂——

lines.en: And flesh untucked from dermal homes-
lines.zh: 血肉从皮肤的居所里翻出——

lines.en: The sky is where we find salvation.
lines.zh: 天空才是我们寻得救赎的地方。

lines.en: Our final sight and last sensation.
lines.zh: 我们最后的景象，最后的感觉。

lines.en: As eyes roll back, and respiration-
lines.zh: 当眼睛翻白，而呼吸——

lines.en: Contorts our lungs in expiration-
lines.zh: 在吐气的最后一刻扭曲我们的肺——

lines.en: We’ll rely on half-unpacked narration
lines.zh: 我们将依赖那些半解开的叙述

lines.en: And take shelter in these new vibrations.
lines.zh: 并在这些新的振动中寻求庇护。

lines.en: This one was me.
lines.zh: 这一次是我。

lines.en: But I wish that it wasn’t.
lines.zh: 但我希望不是。

lines.en: So I’ll forget it immediately.
lines.zh: 所以我要立刻把它忘掉。

lines.en: There is no narrator I can ever rely on.
lines.zh: 没有一个叙述者是我能信赖的。

lines.en: Everyone just wants to break me.
lines.zh: 每个人都只想弄垮我。

lines.en: But no one can finish the job.
lines.zh: 可谁都没法把活干完。
